description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ModulesAPI class within the OrangeHRM Admin API module. It tests retrieval and update operations on modules, as well as placeholder methods for create, get, and delete operations which are marked as not implemented.

classes.name: ModulesAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ModulesAPI endpoints, including getAll, update, and placeholder tests for create, get, and delete operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating specific tables before each test.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all modules via the getAll API endpoint using data providers.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating modules via the update API endpoint, including mock user setup.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Validates that the create method in ModulesAPI throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates that the validation rules for create throw a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Validates that the getOne method in ModulesAPI throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates that validation rules for getOne throw a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Validates that the delete method in ModulesAPI throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates that validation rules for delete throw a not-implemented exception.
